target_customer: Industrial distributors and manufacturers with quote-heavy sales and procurement
problem: Distributors answer RFQs by hand across email, PDFs, spreadsheets and ERP systems, so quotes are slow and bids are lost. Hexa agents automate that workflow.
business_model: B2B SaaS agents sold to distributors (pricing not disclosed)
product_category: AI agents for industrial distribution operations

founders.name: Ishaan Makkar
prior_employers: A manufacturer where he built the automations Hexa sells (name not stated)
previous_startups: B2B ed-tech startup with 70+ partners and 5,000+ users (outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: YC page says his family runs one of India's largest paper producers.

founders.name: Mann Patira
education: MEng ML and AI, Imperial College London

founders.name: Auri Nayak
founders.background_notes: Surname appears in a search result, not the YC page, which lists only Auri.

competitors.name: Proton.ai
competitors.what: Agentic order and quote entry automation for distributors
competitors.traction_then: General availability July 2026; reports 75% cut in list preparation time (vendor claim)

competitors.name: Motivate
competitors.what: AI platform for order intake, quoting and pricing at small and midsize distributors

technical_complexity.rationale: Parsing messy RFQs and writing into ERPs such as SAP and NetSuite is integration-heavy but within reach of a small team using modern LLMs.

defensibility.rationale: ERP integrations create stickiness, but Proton.ai and others shipped similar quote automation in the same months.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Unknown so far; a 2026 article says Fastenal bought an agentic AI company, Rampp.ai.

market_need_then: A 2026 article cites McKinsey finding 60% of public distributors mentioned AI in recent statements, and Rexel reports over 50% of US quoting teams use AI tools. Hexa reports 3 customers paying $9k monthly (per a YC tier list site, unverified).

branding.domain_note: Uses hexaagents.com, a suffixed domain; hexa.com belongs to a Paris startup studio.

identity.logo: Hexa logo with YC backing mark

brand_strength.rationale: Search results were dominated by other Hexa companies (startup studio, wallet, capital fund) and nothing about this brand.

outcome_analysis: Hexa is an active Spring 2026 YC company with a three person team combining a manufacturing-adjacent CEO, a Bloomberg and Autodesk CTO and a PE background COO. No outcome exists yet. Early traction is reported only by a third party, and the key risk is rivals like Proton.ai shipping quote automation in the same months.
notes: Funding unverified: FundedIQ and VCBacked list a $500K pre-seed in 2026-06 with Y Combinator; Yespress mentions a seed in 2026-03 with no amount. Aggregators only, so no round recorded. Company site says backed by Y Combinator and OpenAI with no amounts. Location conflict: London on YC, Newark and San Francisco on aggregators. Traction figure comes from a YC tier list site, unverified. No shutdown or acquisition found.
